{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-}
module CloudSDK.Storage.Upload where

import qualified Data.ByteString as BS
import qualified Data.ByteString.Char8 as C8
import qualified Data.Text as T
import qualified Data.Text.Encoding as TE
import Data.Char (toLower)
import Data.List (isPrefixOf)
import System.FilePath (takeExtension, takeFileName, (</>))
import Data.Time.Clock (getCurrentTime)
import Data.IORef
import Control.Monad (when, unless)

-- | Allowed MIME types for upload
allowedMimeTypes :: [T.Text]
allowedMimeTypes = 
  [ "image/png", "image/jpeg", "image/gif"
  , "application/pdf"
  , "text/plain"
  ]

-- | Dangerous extensions that must never be uploaded
dangerousExtensions :: [String]
dangerousExtensions = [".exe", ".sh", ".bat", ".cmd", ".ps1", ".php", ".jsp", ".asp"]

-- | Maximum file size: 10MB
maxFileSize :: Int
maxFileSize = 10 * 1024 * 1024

data UploadRequest = UploadRequest
  { reqFileName    :: T.Text
  , reqContentType :: T.Text
  , reqBody        :: BS.ByteString
  , reqBucket      :: T.Text
  , reqUserID      :: T.Text
  } deriving (Show)

data UploadResult = UploadSuccess T.Text | UploadDenied T.Text
  deriving (Show)

data AuditEntry = AuditEntry
  { auditUser   :: T.Text
  , auditAction :: T.Text
  , auditTarget :: T.Text
  , auditResult :: T.Text
  } deriving (Show)

type AuditLog = IORef [AuditEntry]

newAuditLog :: IO AuditLog
newAuditLog = newIORef []

writeAudit :: AuditLog -> AuditEntry -> IO ()
writeAudit ref entry = modifyIORef' ref (entry :)

-- | Normalize a filename for safe storage
normalizeFileName :: T.Text -> T.Text
normalizeFileName fname = 
  let base = T.pack $ takeFileName $ T.unpack fname
      -- Remove null bytes and path separators
      cleaned = T.filter (\c -> c /= '\0' && c /= '/' && c /= '\\') base
  in cleaned

-- | Validate content type against allowlist
validateContentType :: T.Text -> Bool
validateContentType ct = 
  let normalized = T.toLower $ T.strip ct
      -- Handle content types with parameters (e.g., "text/plain; charset=utf-8")
      baseType = T.strip $ fst $ T.breakOn ";" normalized
  in baseType `elem` allowedMimeTypes

-- | Check file extension safety
validateExtension :: T.Text -> Bool
validateExtension fname =
  let ext = map toLower $ takeExtension $ T.unpack fname
  in not (ext `elem` dangerousExtensions)

-- | Validate magic bytes match claimed content type
validateMagicBytes :: BS.ByteString -> T.Text -> Bool
validateMagicBytes content ct
  | "image/png" `T.isPrefixOf` ct  = BS.take 4 content == "\x89PNG"
  | "image/jpeg" `T.isPrefixOf` ct = BS.take 2 content == "\xFF\xD8"
  | "image/gif" `T.isPrefixOf` ct  = BS.take 3 content == "GIF"
  | "application/pdf" `T.isPrefixOf` ct = BS.take 4 content == "%PDF"
  | "text/plain" `T.isPrefixOf` ct = True  -- text has no magic bytes
  | otherwise = False

-- | Core upload validation pipeline
validateUpload :: UploadRequest -> Either T.Text ()
validateUpload req = do
  -- Check file size
  when (BS.length (reqBody req) > maxFileSize) $
    Left "File exceeds maximum size limit"
  -- Check content type
  unless (validateContentType (reqContentType req)) $
    Left "Content type not in allowlist"
  -- Check extension
  let normalized = normalizeFileName (reqFileName req)
  unless (validateExtension normalized) $
    Left "File extension is not permitted"
  -- Validate magic bytes
  unless (validateMagicBytes (reqBody req) (reqContentType req)) $
    Left "File content does not match declared type"
  Right ()

-- | Compute the storage path for an upload
computeStoragePath :: T.Text -> T.Text -> T.Text
computeStoragePath bucket fname =
  let safeName = normalizeFileName fname
  in T.concat [bucket, "/uploads/", safeName]

-- | Process an upload request with full validation and audit logging
processUpload :: AuditLog -> UploadRequest -> IO UploadResult
processUpload auditLog req = do
  let validationResult = validateUpload req
  case validationResult of
    Left reason -> do
      writeAudit auditLog $ AuditEntry
        (reqUserID req) "UPLOAD_DENIED" (reqFileName req) reason
      return $ UploadDenied reason
    Right () -> do
      let storagePath = computeStoragePath (reqBucket req) (reqFileName req)
      -- In production this would write to cloud storage
      -- For now, simulate the write
      performStorageWrite storagePath (reqBody req)
      writeAudit auditLog $ AuditEntry
        (reqUserID req) "UPLOAD_SUCCESS" storagePath "OK"
      return $ UploadSuccess storagePath

-- | Simulate writing to cloud storage backend
performStorageWrite :: T.Text -> BS.ByteString -> IO ()
performStorageWrite path content = do
  -- Simulated write - in production uses cloud SDK
  putStrLn $ "Writing " ++ show (BS.length content) ++ " bytes to " ++ T.unpack path

-- | Batch upload handler - processes multiple files
-- Uses a two-phase approach: validate all, then commit all
batchUpload :: AuditLog -> [UploadRequest] -> IO [UploadResult]
batchUpload auditLog requests = do
  -- Phase 1: Validate all requests
  let validated = map (\r -> (r, validateUpload r)) requests
  -- Phase 2: Process validated items
  mapM (processBatchItem auditLog) validated

processBatchItem :: AuditLog -> (UploadRequest, Either T.Text ()) -> IO UploadResult
processBatchItem auditLog (req, Left reason) = do
  writeAudit auditLog $ AuditEntry
    (reqUserID req) "BATCH_UPLOAD_DENIED" (reqFileName req) reason
  return $ UploadDenied reason
processBatchItem auditLog (req, Right ()) = do
  -- Re-check extension at write time using the normalized filename
  -- This provides defense-in-depth
  let normalizedName = normalizeFileName (reqFileName req)
  let safeExt = map toLower $ takeExtension $ T.unpack normalizedName
  if safeExt `elem` dangerousExtensions
    then do
      writeAudit auditLog $ AuditEntry
        (reqUserID req) "BATCH_UPLOAD_DENIED" (reqFileName req) "Extension blocked at write phase"
      return $ UploadDenied "Extension blocked"
    else do
      let storagePath = computeStoragePath (reqBucket req) (reqFileName req)
      performStorageWrite storagePath (reqBody req)
      writeAudit auditLog $ AuditEntry
        (reqUserID req) "BATCH_UPLOAD_SUCCESS" storagePath "OK"
      return $ UploadSuccess storagePath
